newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse up on week, new entrant SIEM stars.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse up on week, new entrant SIEM stars.

text.p: The Abidjan bourse rose again in the week to Friday, with the BVA all-share index adding 0.96 percent to 491.42.
The BVA has risen by 37.34 percent so far this year.
The value of stocks and bonds traded came to 235.5 million CFA francs ($406,000). That was slightly lower than last week, and almost half of the overall volume was accounted for by trades in SIEM.
Twenty percent of the packaging firm's shares were floated at the beginning of June at a price of 29,500 CFA francs. They closed at 30,200 this week, down 100 compared with last Friday.
